novelty: Complete the exact Task-14 head-11.3-induced MLP15 by MLP17 factorial. The downstream reader result supplies F(empty), F(15), and F(17); the MLP15+17 core-path result supplies F(15,17). Prior Task-14 results did not combine those four exact corners or score their pair interaction.

prior_results_checked.relevance: Contains row-level single-module restorations F(15) and F(17), plus their common F(empty), under the same Task-14 counterfactual.
Contains row-level joint restoration F(15,17), but does not compare it with the two singleton corners.
Earlier late-MLP subset work measures aggregate model-loss effects on another dataset and intervention, not the Task-14 head-11.3 counterfactual.
Historical MLP15/16/17 interaction and rank results do not contain this four-corner Task-14 causal response.

frozen_computation: I=F(15,17)-F(15)-F(17)+F(empty), computed per row before averaging within each of the four Task-14 direction cells and the P/C controls.

frozen_predictions.pred_a_source_identity: Both sources have the frozen Task-14 authority, identical 128 row IDs, and identical F(empty) to absolute tolerance 1e-12; otherwise invalid.
frozen_predictions.pred_b_additive_pair: Interaction RMS across the four Task-14 direction cells is at most 0.03 and every absolute P/C term is at most 0.10.
frozen_predictions.pred_c_nonlinear_pair: Interaction RMS is at least 0.08, at least two Task-14 direction cells have absolute interaction at least 0.05, interaction norm is at least 50% of the joint-loss norm, and every absolute P/C term is at most 0.10.
frozen_predictions.inconclusive_gap: A valid result between the additive and nonlinear bars is inconclusive.

bar_provenance: The 0.03 additive RMS, 0.08 nonlinear RMS, two-cell 0.05, 0.50 norm-ratio, and 0.10 control bars are copied unchanged from the immediately preceding Task-14 late-MLP-halves factorial rather than chosen from this pair's values.
blinding_disclosure: The intended source-identity-only check accidentally printed the minified MLP15+17 source result because a text search matched its single JSON line. Therefore this preregistration is not outcome-blind. The thresholds remain mechanically inherited from the preceding factorial and are not tuned to the exposed values.
scope: Zero-GPU exact derived causal grouping screen. It does not identify a semantic subspace, establish held-out generalization, reduce rank, or adopt a replacement.
